The user approved the A1+ Unit 2 plan on 2026-11-19 (A1+ 2.Y follows A1 2.Y, one grammar step each) and chose "Straight to Preview": no per-lesson gates, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, reviewed in Preview. Batch C (2.11-2.15) was started on 2026-11-20 on the user's "Start Batch C when Preview is done". Each photo shows one cast member in the same classroom doing what the command names: Diego seated and standing, Sofia writing her name on paper and scribbling on the desk, Luis eating a sandwich and Ana using her phone. The teacher is never pictured; the teacher's voice gives the commands and the co-teacher says what the student does. Command banks set the positive against the negative (Don't use your phone. / Use your phone.) and Sit down against Stand up.

lesson.title: 2.12 Don't eat in the classroom
lesson.unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
lesson.goal: Understand and say classroom commands, and Don't for what not to do (Sit down. / Write your name. / Don't eat in the classroom.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.12 In the Classroom: A1 names the classroom, the desk and the things on it; A1+ 2.12 gives classroom commands with the base form of the verb and no subject (Sit down. / Write your name.), and Don't before the verb for what not to do (Don't eat in the classroom.), A1+ 1.8's don't now in a command. The teacher's voice gives each command to the student in the photo, who is doing what the command names: Diego sits at his desk and stands beside it, Sofia writes her name on paper and scribbles on the desk, Luis eats a sandwich and Ana uses her phone. The co-teacher says what the student does, bringing back A1+ 1.2's writes and 1.7's studies.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 2.12 classroom, desk, paper; A1 3.x your name; A1+ 1.8 don't; A1+ 1.2 writes; A1+ 1.7 studies; A1 5.x eat; A1 phone; A1 use.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say Don't with a clear t before the verb (DON'T eat), and Sit down / Stand up as one phrase with the stress on the second word. Do not require native-like speed.
